subject: math
description: Use the Law of Cosines to find an unknown side in oblique triangles when SAS or SSS information is given.
learningObjectives: Identify when SAS information calls for the Law of Cosines
Use the Law of Cosines to find an unknown side
Substitute side lengths and an included angle accurately
Recognize how the Law of Cosines connects to the Pythagorean Theorem
Estimate whether a computed side length is reasonable
